item.tib: grib sel gsal ba'i me long
item.coloph: grib sel gsal byed me long 'di/ slob dpon rig 'dzin chen po'i (pos/)dus mtha'i rnal 'byor bdag la rgyud (brgyud/)sbas dang gsang rgya thub par byas/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyongs (skyong) srung ma rnams la bzod par gsol//
